mechanism_narrative: A lower current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% signals economic weakness and reduced corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and 20-day SPX returns over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in monthly employment (PAYEMS) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a labor market overheating without corresponding supply expansion, generating inflationary pressures that prompt central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises and INDPRO falls, or the Rank IC between the interaction term (PAYEMS growth * INDPRO decline) and 20-day SPX returns over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), a higher federal funds rate compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate applied to future cash flows, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is rising (indicating a tightening cycle), or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns during tightening cycles is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher current industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above 105, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and 60-day SPX returns over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 thousand units signals a weakening housing market and broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is below 1200, or the Rank IC between HOUST and 20-day SPX returns over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based consumer demand slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both decline, or the Rank IC between the interaction term (HOUST decline * RSAFS decline) and 20-day SPX returns over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A lower current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 5-day SPX returns over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
